description: This file contains extension methods for the ShellSettings class in the OrchardCore project, providing configuration and retrieval of database table options such as document table name, table name separator, and identity column size.

classes.name: ShellSettingsExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ShellSettings to manage database table options.

methods.name: GetDatabaseTableOptions
methods.description: Retrieves database table options from ShellSettings.

methods.name: ConfigureDatabaseTableOptions
methods.description: Configures ShellSettings with database table options if not already initialized.

methods.name: GetDocumentTable
methods.description: Gets the document table name from ShellSettings, defaulting to 'Document'.

methods.name: GetTableNameSeparator
methods.description: Gets the table name separator, defaulting to '_', with validation.

methods.name: GetIdentityColumnSize
methods.description: Gets the identity column size, defaulting to 'Int64' or 'Int32', with validation.
